remission.title: Stable Condition / In Remission
remission.message: Great news! Your logs indicate gut stability today. Keep up your healthy habits and prescribed medications.
remission.care_habits: Maintain a balanced diet and regular daily hydration.
remission.care_medication: Continue maintenance therapy as prescribed by your gastroenterologist.

mild.title: Mild Activity Observed
mild.message: We noticed mild fluctuations today. Stay well hydrated, avoid trigger foods, and continue monitoring your stools.
mild.care_hydration: Drink at least 2 to 3 liters of water and clear fluids throughout the day.
mild.care_diet: Avoid greasy foods, ultra-processed items, excess caffeine, and lactose if sensitive.
mild.care_monitor: Monitor if symptoms persist for more than 48 hours.

flare.title: Flare-up Alert: Support & Guidance
flare.message: Take a deep breath; flare-ups are challenging but temporary. We are here with you. Please review the safety guidelines below:
flare.care_hydration: Rehydrate with water, oral rehydration solutions, or electrolyte drinks to replace losses.
flare.care_no_nsaids: WARNING: NEVER take NSAIDs (like ibuprofen, ketoprofen, or diclofenac), as they worsen gut inflammation.
flare.care_contact_doctor: Notify your gastroenterologist about increased bowel frequency or blood in stool.
flare.care_red_flags: Go to the emergency room immediately if you have fever > 38°C (100.4°F), severe dizziness, extreme weakness, or continuous heavy bleeding.

poolingMorning.title: Morning Blood Pooling
poolingMorning.message: During sleep, reduced motility allows blood and mucus to collect in the rectal vault. Passing this upon waking is expected in active UC and doesn't necessarily mean an acute active hemorrhage.
poolingMorning.action: Monitor subsequent bowel movements throughout the day calmly.

tenesmusSupport.title: Urgency with Gas (Rectal Tenesmus)
tenesmusSupport.message: Rectal mucosal inflammation triggers false urgency signals to the brain. Feeling intense urgency but only passing gas or blood traces is part of active inflammation.
tenesmusSupport.action: Take a deep breath. You are doing everything right.

emergency.title: 🚨 RED ALERT: Seek Immediate Emergency Medical Care
emergency.message: We detected a combination of high-risk symptoms (heavy bleeding associated with systemic signs of fever/dizziness or acute severe abdominal pain). Please seek immediate emergency medical evaluation.
emergency.care_hospital: Proceed to the emergency room or contact your gastroenterologist urgently.
emergency.care_hydration: Sip water or oral electrolyte solution in small sips during transport.
emergency.care_no_nsaids: WARNING: NEVER take NSAIDs (ibuprofen, diclofenac, ketoprofen), as they exacerbate gastrointestinal hemorrhage.
emergency.care_monitor: Show your symptom timeline or export the PDF report at hospital triage.
